steps: Boil whole-wheat elbows or shells until tender. Add frozen broccoli and peas for the last 3-4 minutes, then drain and keep 1/4 cup of the cooking water.
In the same pot over low heat, warm the milk with the olive oil. Take it off the heat and stir in the grated cheddar and parmesan until they melt.
Stir the pasta and vegetables back in, loosening with a little of the cooking water. Season with pepper (and mustard powder or paprika if you like) rather than extra salt.
A cheese-based dish: in a Mediterranean pattern cheese is eaten in moderate amounts, so treat this as a step away from the box, not an everyday dinner.

prep.keepsNote: USDA FSIS: cooked leftovers keep 3-4 days refrigerated (3 used as the conservative value); refrigerate within 2 h.

meals.evidenceNote: A same-type swap for boxed mac and cheese, not a trial-tested recipe. Whole-grain pasta instead of refined pasta is supported by meta-analyses of whole-grain and fiber intake (Reynolds 2019; mostly observational, with some trial data on risk factors). Cooking from minimally processed ingredients rather than an ultra-processed mix is supported by the Hall 2019 inpatient RCT (ultra-processed diet: ~500 kcal/day more eaten ad libitum) and by DGA 2025-2030. Cheese is a moderation food in Mediterranean patterns (Bach-Faig 2011), so this meal is rated moderate rather than strong. Nutrition computed from USDA FDC SR Legacy per-100 g values x ingredient grams.
